title: I built a free, local AI assistant for your Robinhood account (No cloud fees, easy setup)
author: Deep_Distribution769
selftext:
Like a lot of you, I've been tracking Robinhood's recent launch of their new agent trading features. The concept is awesome, but tuning prompts or testing out workflows on cloud-heavy setups (like Claude Desktop, Cursor, or ChatGPT) can rack up a massive API bill quickly when you are just trying to experiment and test things out.

To make it completely free to mess around with, I open-sourced **ollama-robin** and published it to PyPI.

It runs entirely on your local hardware using **Ollama** and **Gemma 4**, meaning you can run thousands of prompt tests, experiment with tool-calling, and map out your own workflows without paying a dime in third-party API fees.

# 📌 Just a Starting Template

To be completely clear: **this is a foundation.** It is designed to act as an accessible starting block. It provides a clean terminal interface and the structural wiring so you can take it, strip out the pieces you don't need, and plug in your own logic, custom trading indicators, or execution strategies.

# ⚙️ Before You Run It (The Checklist)

Because this runs 100% locally on your machine, you'll need a couple of quick things set up before launching the package:

1. **Ollama Installed:** You need the free Ollama app running in the background on your machine.
2. **Gemma 4 Pulled:** The package is optimized out-of-the-box for Google's new edge model. Just open your terminal and pull it down: Bash ollama pull gemma4:e4b 

​

    3. **Set Up Your Env File:** Before you run the app command, you need to create a `.env.local` file in your project folder and add your standard **Robinhood email and password**. This is what lets the local tool talk directly to your account. (You can also optionally add an **Exa Search key** if you want to give the AI live internet access to research market news!)
    
    ### 📦 Quick Start
    Once your env file is ready and Ollama is running, you can install and launch the template with just two terminal commands:
    
    ```bash
    pip install ollama-robin
    ollama-robin
    

*Note: If you have 2FA/MFA turned on for your Robinhood account, the app will safely pause on startup and let you type your SMS or authenticator security code right into the terminal window.*

The project is completely free and open-source under a permissive license. Feel free to grab the code, use it as a sandbox to see how local AI tool-calling handles real financial endpoints, and customize it however you want. Let me know what you think or what features you'd add to the template!

* 🐙 **GitHub Repository:** [https://github.com/MeanFishy00/ollama-robin](https://github.com/MeanFishy00/ollama-robin)
* 🐍 **PyPI Page:** [https://pypi.org/project/ollama-robin/](https://pypi.org/project/ollama-robin/)
